2 · Print zones & general print requirements 印花位置与通用要求

Zone A centre front (shown with design 01) · Zone B back-neck logo · Zone C inside tagless label
A 前中印花区（以01款为例）· B 后领标志 · C 内领印标

Placement 位置

  • All artwork centred on centre-front line; top edge measured from CF neck point (lowest point of front neckline). Tolerance ±3 mm, rotation ±1°. 所有图案以前中线居中；顶边自前领中点量起。公差±3mm，旋转±1°。
  • Print on relaxed (unstretched) garment on a flat platen. 松弛平铺状态下印花。
  • Same artwork size for XS–L (no grading). XS–L 使用同一尺寸图案，不放码。

Inks & durability 油墨与牢度

  • Fabric is 4-way stretch: use stretch additive / elastic binder. Test: stretch 30 % – no cracking. 面料四面弹：须加弹性助剂。拉伸30%不龟裂。
  • Soft hand feel; avoid thick plastisol deposits except where puff is specified. 手感柔软；除指定发泡外避免厚胶浆。
  • Wash test: 5 cycles at 30 °C inside out – no cracking, fading or peeling (DTF). 水洗测试：30°C反面洗5次，无龟裂、褪色、脱落。
  • Cure per ink datasheet (plastisol 160 °C full cure; water-based 150 °C 2–3 min). 按油墨规格固化。

Minimums 最小值

  • Positive line 0.5 mm; text cap height 2.0 mm; halftone dot 0.45 mm; keylines as drawn. 正线0.5mm；字高2.0mm；网点0.45mm。
  • Mesh: 120–156 T solids, 180–200 T fine lines/halftone. 网目：实色120–156目，细线/网点180–200目。

Colour 颜色

  • Match to HEX / CMYK given on each page; Pantone Solid Coated is a nearest reference only. 以各页 HEX/CMYK 为准，潘通仅作参考。
  • Strike-offs of every colour on the actual white rib fabric for approval before bulk. 大货前须在实际面料上做印花样确认。

5 · Approval process, QC & order form 确认流程、质检与订单表

Approval steps 确认步骤

  1. Fabric swatch + strike-offs of all colours on actual fabric (photo in daylight + physical) 面料小样 + 全色印花样（日光下照片 + 实物）
  2. Pre-production sample, size S, designs 01 / 02 / 05 / 07 first, then the rest 产前样，S码，先做 01/02/05/07，其余随后
  3. Customer PP approval in writing 客户书面确认产前样
  4. Bulk production; keep 1 sealed sample per design 大货生产；每款封样1件
  5. Final inspection AQL 2.5 (major) / 4.0 (minor), photos before shipping 终检 AQL 2.5/4.0，出货前拍照

QC checklist 质检要点

  • Print position ±3 mm; no ghosting, pinholes, fibrillation 印花位置±3mm；无重影、针孔、起毛
  • Colour within ΔE 2 of approved strike-off 颜色与确认样 ΔE≤2
